annotations.title: List offers to introduce you to an employer (Vermittlung)

description: Use this when the user asks whether Jobroulette wants to introduce them to an employer for a job (Vermittlung). Returns the introduction offers: at which employer Jobroulette would like to present the user, which job it is about and when the user was asked. Only the user can accept an offer, on the Jobroulette website: `zustimmungsseite` is the page where they do it — give them this link. Scope: cv:lesen.

nurOffene.description: Only the unanswered offers. false also returns the answered ones.
